# FlexibleAdapter source dependency

Source: https://github.com/arkon/FlexibleAdapter
Commit: c80135339bcff5f7f8c2c2380329dfc155b26232
License: Apache-2.0 (LICENSE retained).

The original JitPack artifact `com.github.arkon.FlexibleAdapter:flexible-adapter:c8013533`
was unavailable in the private build on 2026-10-19. The matching main Java/resource
sources are included here unchanged. The manifest package moved to Gradle namespace,
and the former generated VERSION_NAME is supplied by this module's build file.
